text:
maria: Heads-up — AcmePay just escalated. They get occasional parse errors from JSON-mode responses (customer uses structured_output=true). ~2% of calls fail with invalid JSON and that spikes errors in their downstream parser.

alex: can you paste a failing response + request_id?

maria: pasted a scrubbed example below. request_id=rid_2026_03_10_0421, call took 420ms but the response body is malformed. See logs: 
```
RESPONSE (rid_2026_03_10_0421):
{"invoice_id": "inv_123", "amount": 1200, "items": [
  {"name": "Widget A", "qty": 2}
  {"name": "Gizmo B", "qty": 1}
], "customer": {"name": "[REDACTED]"}}
```
Notice missing comma between items objects.

ingrid: any trace link? might be a streaming boundary / truncation issue.

maria: trace: https://rwd-console.internal/traces/rid_2026_03_10_0421 (internal link). I checked: upstream streaming finished; runtime reported 200. Also saw these in Sentry as JSONDecodeError in AcmePay's parser.

oncall-ml: quick checks — is the model being switched mid-response (fallback to smaller model) or any truncated retry? That can create partial output.

alex: I pulled the serve logs for that request. We did a model fallback -> yes, fallback happened at token 42 due to a GPU OOM on the A100 pool. Runtime did streaming fallback to a quantized variant. Looks like KV cache replayed but one of the chunk boundaries didn't re-emit a separator token.

sam: OOM fallback causing malformed JSON is bad. We should 1) add stronger validation at the runtime boundary (if structured_output=true fail-open vs fail-closed behavior?), 2) log a metric for "structured_output_malformed" so we can alert.

maria: Customer asked for quick mitigation: can we add an endpoint-side sanitization that tries to auto-repair simple JSON issues (insert missing commas/brackets) or at least return a 5xx so they can retry? They prefer a 5xx instead of bad JSON.

alex: +1 on 5xx. If structured_output=true we should treat any truncated/invalid JSON as internal error and return 502 or a structured_error with reason. I can add a validation pass in the API gateway. But need to ensure we don't expose redacted PII in the validation errors.

ingrid: for observability: add a trace tag when fallback occurs and annotate whether the fallback model is quantized. Also emit a counter metric: rwd.structured_output.invalid_json with labels {model_variant, fallback=true/false, customer_tier}. Create a dashboard with 1h/24h trend and top request_ids.

maria: Also customer says their parser fails silently if there's trailing garbage after JSON (we should detect trailing tokens).

alex: plan: (1) Runtime: add validation on final assembled streaming output before we mark request done. If invalid JSON -> throw an internal error and force fallback to full deterministic re-generation (sync) OR return 502. (2) API: short-term add gateway sanitizer that returns structured_error with "malformed_structured_output" and scrubbed snippet. (3) Observability: emit rwd.structured_output.invalid_json counter + histogram for latency of such errors + link traces. (4) Postmortem: detect and add regression test to streaming fallback that asserts separators preserved.

sam: Can we also add log redaction rules so validation errors in logs print "[SNIPPET_REDACTED]" instead of showing PII? Right now some snippets include email tokens.

alex: yes — any snippet emitted to customer-facing logs must run through our PII redactor. Internal traces can keep the full text but access-controlled. We'll add a boolean flag allow_full_snippet to the trace event.

oncall-ml: I'll take ownership of the runtime validation change. ETA 2d for a patch to detect invalid JSON and trigger deterministic re-gen or 502. Will also add unit tests for common schema drift cases (missing comma, trailing text, unclosed braces, extra tokens).

ingrid: I'll add metrics + Grafana panel. Quick queries: 
- counter: rwd.structured_output.invalid_json{job="api-gateway"} by model_variant
- histogram: rwd.structured_output.latency_bucket by status
And an alert: if rate > 0.5% over 1h for any paying customer send page.

maria: Customer wants a temporary workaround: they will set a client-side retry on 5xx only. Can we push a fast rollback so faulty calls return 502 instead of bad 200?

alex: we can patch the gateway to run the validator in front of returning 200. That is a config flag per-customer (they have enterprise plan). I'll flip it for AcmePay now and notify them.

support-bot: NOTE: AcmePay escalation ticket #INC-7832 created and linked. Assignee: alex. Priority: high.

sam: make sure we add a runbook entry in support playbook: how to triage structured_output errors — include quick grep patterns for "JSONDecodeError" and query to find fallback events.

maria: I'll notify customer and recommend they enable retry-on-5xx for now. Also will provide the scrubbed failing snippets for their devs.

alex: update: patched gateway flag for AcmePay to validate structured output and return 502 on invalid JSON. Pushed at 15:12 UTC. Monitoring hook added.

ingrid: saw 3 invalid_json events for AcmePay in next 30min then dropped to 0. Dashboard updated.

maria: customer confirmed reduced errors, asked for timeline for permanent fix. I'll follow up with PR ETA.

alex: PR opened: rwd/runtime#2045. Description: validate assembled streaming output for structured mode; on invalid JSON trigger sync re-generation once; if still invalid return 502 and emit metric. Reviews requested.

oncall-ml: leaving a checklist in the PR for testcases + stress test.

maria: thanks team :heart: — I'll keep this thread updated and close after runtime deploy and a 24h stability window.

sam: nice work. :tada:
